title: UK Food Hygiene Ratings - FSA Business Data

name.title: Business name
name.description: Name to search; clear this for all businesses in your selected area.

address.title: Town, address or postcode
address.description: Address search sent to the FSA. Clear this to search all areas.

localAuthorityId.title: Local authority ID
localAuthorityId.description: Optional numeric FSA API local authority ID; 0 means no filter. This is not localAuthorityCode.

businessTypeId.title: Business type ID
businessTypeId.description: Optional numeric FSA business type ID; 0 means no filter. Restaurant/Cafe/Canteen is 1.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Maximum unique records saved and billed across this run.

pageSize.title: Source page size
pageSize.description: At most 100 source records per request; also capped by maxItems.

maxPages.title: Maximum source pages
maxPages.description: Stop after this many pages, even if filters find fewer results. Includes empty pages.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Request interval (seconds)
requestDelaySeconds.description: Minimum interval between all requests. A longer robots.txt delay takes precedence.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Off by default. Optional Apify Proxy requires your Apify account configuration. Proxies never override robots.txt or access restrictions.
